utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Friday the twenty-second. Can you all hear me, or am I doing the silent film again?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: We can hear you. Um, more importantly, there's a birthday cake in the office.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: That's the clearest bit of communication we've had all week.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And the charity bake sale on Friday — today. Dangerous day to have forgotten your breakfast.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Forgotten? That's a deliberate strategy.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: The cake's already been cut, before anyone thinks I'm organising something here.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Right, excellent. Cake situation understood. Finished stuff first?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, I signed off the inspection on the wrapper on Tuesday. That's closed, nothing new off that.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Cheers, Grace. That can stay in the done pile.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I finished the repair on the Palletiser last night as well. That repair's complete.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, although there's the jam on the palletizer to talk about. Not saying your finished repair is still open.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: No, exactly. The repair from last night is done. Separate conversation.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And I finished the repair on the line 2 robot last night. That's done too, not another one for today.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Lovely. Any observations before we get into the actual jobs?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I saw the pressure on the line one HPU dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own. Just an observation.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Right, so that's not a new investigation being allocated here.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Correct. It recovered on its own; just giving you the picture.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And I can't get to the Line 1 Mould Temperature Controller until production gives us a window. Still blocked.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, there's no window confirmed for that. Can't pretend there is.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Understood. Blocked, not a commitment for today.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Oh, and we were going to replace the belt on the line 3 barrel but that's been pushed to next month so ignore it.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: The belt, yeah. Bearings are a separate thing, though?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: They are. Tom, can you grease and check the bearings on the line 3 barrel today? No belt replacement in that.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll grease and check the bearings on the line 3 barrel today. Just the bearings, understood.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Thanks, Tom. That's agreed.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the Line 3 Chiller by the end of the week. That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Thanks, Callum. By the end of the week, and first for you because it's holding production up.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Exactly. I'll take the permit to work and isolation, yes.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I'll replace the seals on the boiler feed pump on Friday. It's urgent, that one.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Okay, Grace. The seals on the boiler feed pump, on Friday — today — and urgent.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yes, today. I'll take that.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Right. Definitely not everything in the 'when you fancy it' category, then.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Definitely not. Olumide Adeyemi, can you clear the jam and check the sensors on the palletizer? Top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll clear the jam and check the sensors on the palletizer. I'll take it as top priority.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you — just keeping that distinct from the repair I finished last night.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, understood. I'm taking the jam and sensor check, not reopening your repair.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Good. Top priority for that, agreed.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: On the buying side, I'll chase the purchase order for the water system this morning.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Is that an urgent chase, or just whenever you get a chance?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Whenever you get a chance sort of priority. I'll fit the chase in this morning, though.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Okay, PR. Purchase order for the water system, this morning, whenever you get a chance. Got it.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Cheers. That's the chase covered, then.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I've got the pressure one as well. I'll investigate the pressure drop on the Boiler Feedwater Pump by the 28th. Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Just so I've got that straight, normal priority for the investigation, rather than the urgency on the seals?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yes. Normal priority for the pressure-drop investigation, by the 28th. The seal replacement is the urgent one.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Thanks, Grace. Separate entries, separate priorities. Clear.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And I'll organise the toolbox talk for the team after lunch.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Thanks, PR. Whenever you get a chance after lunch — that doesn't need to jump ahead of the urgent stuff.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll organise it after lunch, whenever I get a chance. That's fine.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Toolbox talk versus cake. Tough audience you've got there.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: It's organising the talk, not a promise of cake with every safety message.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And I'll send the shift handover report round Monday. No rush on that one.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Monday for the report, Davey? Not expecting it in amongst all this?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That's right. I'll send it round Monday, no rush.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Good. For a second I thought we'd somehow got to Monday already.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Don't do that. I've only just mentally arrived at Friday's bake sale.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Right. And nothing's quietly slipped in from the blocked or cancelled list?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: No. Line 1 Mould Temperature Controller is still blocked on access. Not down as something I'm doing today.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And the belt replacement on the line 3 barrel is still pushed to next month. Not part of today's bearings job.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Good. Any crossed wires on what we've actually agreed?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: No, all clear from me. Urgent seals and normal-priority pressure investigation, kept separate.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Lovely. Thanks, everyone. I'll let you get off Teams before the cake discussion starts again.
